dict.string: Klubbies Events uses the camera to scan an event's QR code, to take a selfie so it can find you in the event's photos, and to take a photo to upload.
Klubbies Events uses the microphone when you record a video to upload to an event.
Klubbies Events lets you pick photos and videos from your library to upload to an event, or a selfie to find your photos.
Klubbies Events saves event photos to your library when you tap Save to Photos.
